name: flare-records
description: Turn pasted refinery and chemical-plant flare data into 15-minute compliance blocks under 40 CFR 63.670: NHVvg, combustion zone net heating value (NHVcz), NHVdil, tip velocity and pilot-flame deviation blocks, with the HON and ethylene rule variants. Cross-checks historian flows, routing and pilot logs, gas analysis revisions, Method 22 observations and a draft periodic report, and lists each mismatch, gap or stale revision with the blocks it affects. For flare-compliance engineers and emissions consultants.
